notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001506293-26-000021, filed February 12, 2026), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed April 8, 2026, accession 0001506293-26-000058), as of the March 27, 2026 record date. LEADER: Ben Silbermann is co-founder and non-executive Chair. The proxy states 46.32% of Class B and 35.33% of total voting power but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the computed figure is in leader.derived. The record-date Class A count (496,121,510) is well below the 10-K cover count (585,458,698 at February 6, 2026) because of a $1.0 billion accelerated share repurchase in March 2026 (Q3 2026 10-Q). The proxy says his figure does not include 8,762,530 Class B shares held by an LLC owned by a trust whose beneficiaries include members of his immediate family, over which he has no voting or dispositive power; those are not added. HOLDERS: largestHolders is null, not empty. The proxy's other 5% holders are Paul Sciarra (32,589,537 Class B, 40.90% of Class B, 31.19% of votes), BlackRock (59,584,440 Class A, 12.01% of Class A, per a 13G/A reporting holdings at December 31, 2025) and The Vanguard Group (60,147,395 Class A, 12.12% of Class A, per a 13G/A reporting holdings at November 29, 2024, which Vanguard said on March 27, 2026 it no longer beneficially owns after an internal realignment); those are percentages of a single class, and only the leader's figure may be derived. BUYBACKS exclude $398.982 million of shares repurchased for tax withholdings on the release of RSUs and RSAs (a separate cash-flow line). The cash-flow line ($927.013 million) is used; the equity statement shows $930.263 million. GEOGRAPHY: United States alone was $2,912.0 million; Europe includes Russia and Turkey (10-K footnotes).

marketcap.notes: Class A is listed on the NYSE as PINS. Class B is unlisted. The filings searched (FY2025 10-K, Q3 2026 10-Q, 2026 proxy) do not state the conversion ratio in words; pricing Class B at one Class A share rests on the equal per-share rights and on the diluted EPS calculation, which 'assumes the conversion of our Class B common stock to Class A common stock'. No preferred stock is outstanding. The Class A count is lower than at the 10-K cover date because of the March 2026 accelerated share repurchase.

pay.notes: Employees: full-time head count at December 31, 2025 from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost (expense lines are described as 'primarily personnel-related' without a total), so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used. Pinterest reused the median employee it identified from its employee population at December 31, 2024, saying no change in 2025 would significantly change the ratio; the median includes equity awards.
